data.description: Long bristles of shadowstuff extend from between the tenebrous worm's armor plates. These bristles react swiftly to attacks, stabbing at any creature that attempts to harm the worm.  Each time a creature attacks a tenebrous worm, it must make a DC %1 Reflex save to avoid being punctured by several bristles.  Each time a creature is punctured by these bristles, it takes 1d4 points of piercing damage and is exposed to the tenebrous worm's poison.  A creature that grapples a tenebrous worm is automatically hurt by these bristles.
data.name: Bristles
